system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: instructions: "A helpful assistant that can check weather and help with various tasks",
system_prompt_style.note: Agent constructed with an `instructions` string; dynamic instructions reachable (examples/with-dynamic-prompts).

observation_format.note: Tool results returned as values/strings to the model.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Ship Zod-typed tools with lifecycle hooks and cancellation
tool_call_format.note: Built on the Vercel `ai` SDK tool-calling API.

tool_count.note: Framework ships no default tool set; the example agent registers one user tool (weatherTool).

edit_primitive.note: No built-in file-editing primitive; tools are user-defined.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Ship Zod-typed tools with lifecycle hooks and cancellation, and connect to [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) servers without extra glue code.
tool_schema_source.note: Zod schemas converted to JSON schema; MCP client shipped.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: connect to [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) servers without extra glue code

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: **[Workflow Engine](https://voltagent.dev/docs/workflows/overview/)**: Describe multi-step automations declaratively rather than stitching together custom control flow.
loop_primitives.note: Agent tool loop (react) default; workflow chains give fixed pipelines.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Define agents with typed roles, tools, memory, and model providers in one place
planning_granularity.note: No plan object in the agent runtime described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Run teams of specialized agents under a supervisor runtime that routes tasks and keeps them in sync.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default example is a single agent; orchestrator_workers reachable via supervisor/sub-agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: **[Supervisors & Sub-Agents](https://voltagent.dev/docs/agents/sub-agents/)**: Run teams of specialized agents under a supervisor runtime that routes tasks
delegation_mechanism.note: Opt-in; the default single agent has no delegation.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The expense approval workflow demonstrates human-in-the-loop automation with suspend/resume capabilities:
human_in_loop.note: Suspend/resume gating is opt-in per workflow step.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Inspect and manage agent memory, context, and conversation history.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Attach durable memory adapters so agents remember important context across runs.
long_term_memory.note: LibSQL/Postgres/Supabase memory adapters plus RAG retrievers (Chroma) for embeddings; default is in-memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Let clients reconnect to in-flight streams after refresh and continue receiving the same response.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Run agent eval suites alongside your workflows to measure and improve agent behavior.
self_verification.note: Evals and guardrails are opt-in, not enabled by default.

rollback.evidence_quote: Define agents with typed roles, tools, memory, and model providers in one place so everything stays organized.
rollback.note: No rollback/undo mechanism described in the runtime feature list.

termination_condition.evidence_locator: docs/testing.md Testing Agents with the AI SDK
termination_condition.note: Generation ends when the model stops (finishReason: "stop").

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: When you run the dev command, tsx will compile and run your code.
execution_isolation.note: Tools execute in-process in the Node server; no sandbox shipped.

filesystem_access.note: In-process Node execution implies host filesystem access.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Intercept and validate agent input or output at runtime to enforce content policies and safety rules.
permission_model.note: Guardrails are opt-in; no default authorisation of tool calls.

tracing.note: VoltOps tracing plus OTel-style exporters (langfuse, vercel-ai-exporter).

replayability.evidence_quote: Analyze complete execution traces to understand agent behavior and optimize performance.
replayability.note: Workflow suspend/resume allows continuation; no bit-exact replay claimed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Run evaluation suites to test agent behavior, accuracy, and performance against benchmarks.

guardrails.evidence_quote: **[Guardrails](https://voltagent.dev/docs/guardrails/overview/)**: Intercept and validate agent input or output at runtime to enforce content policies and safety rules.

target_domain.evidence_quote: AI Agent Engineering Platform built on an Open Source TypeScript AI Agent Framework
target_domain.note: General-purpose framework; examples include research assistant and web/browser agents.

open_source.evidence_quote: Licensed under the MIT License, Copyright © 2026-present VoltAgent.
open_source.note: Framework MIT; VoltOps Console is a hosted/commercial component.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Swap between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or other providers by changing config, not rewriting agent logic.
